request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for Pallas by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Core Rust Libraries, Year 2.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Pallas maintenance and enhancement and a 15,750 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The requested funding is for a part-time Pallas maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD, with the new grant period beginning after the existing contract closes.

Pallas is a collection of Rust crates implementing core Ouroboros and Cardano primitives including CBOR encoding, cryptographic operations, mini-protocol networking, ledger traversal, transaction building, and address handling.
The document states that Pallas is used as shared infrastructure by projects including Aiken, Dolos, Lucid, Oura, Mithril, Amaru, UTxO-RPC, and others.
The document reports Pallas has over 649 pull requests, 199 stars, 91 forks, 60 contributors, and 214,446 crates.io downloads, with GitHub and crates.io links provided for verification.
The proposed work includes essential maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting and audit materials.
The proposal states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.

The document states TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development on schedule, plus Intersect 2025 maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC that is being delivered on schedule.

Treasury administration is proposed through Sundae Labs smart contracts with named TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisignature-style role thresholds, an external Oversight Committee, audit references, and a public dashboard for tracking funds.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA through Intersect for a 12-month Pallas maintenance program by TxPipe, describing Pallas as core open-source Rust infrastructure, giving adoption metrics and governance-process references, and specifying treasury smart contract administration and oversight arrangements.
